name: Gris
source:
Arguably the best lawyer in Temporia, Gris also spends a lot of her free time working as a public servant of the kingdom. She also used most of the money she’s earned as a lawyer to build orphanages or dining halls where the poor could eat. It is rumored that the King and Queen were about to name her as the next chancellor of Eden.

[In game description]
